name: singlet_demux_sample_swap_detection
title: Sample identity verification and swap detection
description: Checks whether the genotypes in each sample's cells match the individual the sample is claimed to come from, and flags swaps and cross-sample contamination. Use after cell calling, with reads at informative sites and an independent reference genotype per individual. The default method sample_aggregate sums per-cell likelihoods per sample. Do not use it to assign individual cells to donors; use demux.donor_assignment_reference_genotypes for that. Writes per-sample calls and scores under uns/sample_identity.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: sample_aggregate sums per-cell likelihoods per sample; demuxlet scores per barcode; vireo_match maps Vireo donors to references.

min_informative_sites.description: Samples with fewer informative sites covered by reads are ambiguous and never called swaps.

min_reads_per_site.description: Minimum reads at a site in a cell for that site to count.

swap_margin_tau.description: Calibrated log-odds of the best alternative over the claimed individual needed for a swap call; null gives scores only.

estimate.description: Fit a per-sample contamination fraction by maximum likelihood.

max_alpha.description: Upper bound of the contamination search.

demuxlet.description: Settings used only when method is demuxlet.

geno_error_offset.description: Offset of the genotype error rate.

geno_error_coeff.description: Slope of the genotype error rate against imputation R squared.

alpha_grid.description: Doublet mixture fractions searched; used only with method demuxlet.

vireo.description: Settings used only when method is vireo_match.

n_init.description: Random restarts of the variational fit.

genotype_tag.description: FORMAT field read from the donor VCF.

seed.description: Random seed for vireo_match restarts; other methods are deterministic.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/sample_identity/call. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: n_samples, n_match, n_swap, n_ambiguous, n_insufficient, tau_used. Counts only, never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
